Sessions of the desktop EduBeam (Bořek Patzák, Jan Stránský, Vít Šmilauer; CTU Prague), GPL.

- `ex01.xml` - `ex03.xml`: the examples shipped with EduBeam 3.5.0 (`edubeam` on PyPI), saved by 3.2.0.
  `ex03.xml` is the worked example of its user guide, set up in kN, kPa and m.
- `session-3.4.3.xml`: a session saved by 3.4.3, with typed uniform, point and temperature loads.
- `session-2.2.6.xml`: written by hand in the 2.2.6 layout its reader still accepted (loads on the
  domain, supports and prescribed displacements as lists on the nodes, positional load values).
  No file saved by 2.2.6 itself was available.
